collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Apprentices say they only get the worst jobs: hear them out, or say that is how everyone learns.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), an apprentice canoe builder, has said what all the apprentices are thinking: they scrape bark and carry logs all day and never learn to shape a hull. (friend), the master builder, did exactly the same when (friend.he/she) was young. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) listens. The apprentices are right: they are useful labor, not students. (friend) gives each of them one hull to shape, under guidance, and still the logs to carry. They grumble less. They learn more.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) says the hard work is the lesson. (subject) does not agree, and starts carving a small canoe in the evenings, alone. (friend) sees it, and says nothing, and the next day hands (subject.him/her) a better knife.
